rooms.1: A shabby flat in London: a plain room with faded blue patterned wallpaper and a worn red striped carpet, an open doorway on the right wall, a blank wooden plaque on the far wall, grey daylight from a window.
rooms.2: A small alcove in a London flat: pale green walls, a sash window with blue panes in the far wall, a door on the left, a low bookcase crammed with old books in the corner on the right, a red striped carpet.
rooms.3: A dark secret passageway: a narrow corridor framed by heavy red-painted timber supports receding into blackness, a dusty red floor, a tiny lit doorway at the far end.
rooms.4: A musty attic: sloping roof beams and dusty planks overhead in perspective, a long wooden floor, cobwebs, old junk shadowy against the walls, a single dusty shaft of light.
rooms.5: Outside an open window on the ledge of a very tall building: looking down from a narrow grey stone ledge at the green squares and streets of London far below, dizzying height.
rooms.6: A sandy beach on a tropical isle: pale sand sloping to a calm turquoise lagoon, a blank wooden warning sign stuck in the sand on the right, a few clouds and seabirds in the sky.
rooms.7: A maze of caves: dark caverns of blue-black rock with arched openings and hanging stalactites, the floor a flow of dark red stone, several shadowy passages leading off, a faint cold light.
rooms.8: A meadow on a tropical island: green grass, a path leading to a small thatched grass shack on a rise, rocky hills and blue sky behind.
rooms.9: Inside a grass shack: a domed frame of bent poles and thatch overhead, light coming through gaps, a rough red wooden table in the middle of a sandy floor.
rooms.10: In the ocean: nothing but open sea stretching to the horizon under a hazy purple sky, gentle swells all around, lonely.
rooms.11: A deep pit: dark rock walls, a pool of murky blue water filling the floor, a shaft of faint light falling from above, a closed door half hidden in the far wall.
rooms.12: A maze of caves: dark caverns of blue-black rock with arched openings and hanging stalactites, the floor a flow of dark red stone, several shadowy passages leading off, a faint cold light.
rooms.13: A maze of caves: dark caverns of blue-black rock with arched openings and hanging stalactites, the floor a flow of dark red stone, several shadowy passages leading off, a faint cold light.
rooms.14: The foot of a cave-ridden hill on a tropical island: rolling red-brown hills dotted with dark cave mouths, a green path winding up towards the top, a purple evening sky.
rooms.15: Inside a tool shed: a long room of red-painted wooden planks in perspective, shelves and pegs on the walls, a bare plank floor, light through gaps in the boards.
rooms.16: A long hallway in dark rock: a low craggy tunnel of black and grey stone receding to a small lit opening at the far end, a dark red floor.
rooms.17: A large cavern on the island: a great cave of brown and olive rock opening to grey light, and a small red wooden tool shed standing inside on the right.
rooms.18: The top of a hill: looking down between red rocky slopes at the island and the sea below, and far off in the distance a small island with palm trees.
rooms.19: A maze of caves: dark caverns of blue-black rock with arched openings and hanging stalactites, the floor a flow of dark red stone, several shadowy passages leading off, a faint cold light.
rooms.20: Aboard a pirate ship anchored offshore: the wooden deck stretching ahead to the bow, a mast rising in the centre, the ship's wheel on a raised platform, the sea all around.
rooms.21: The beach at Treasure Island: white sand curving along the shore, blue sea, a palm tree leaning in from the right, clouds on the horizon.
rooms.22: A spooky old graveyard on a hill under a red striped sunset sky: crooked tombstones, a dead tree, and piles of empty and broken rum bottles everywhere.
rooms.23: A large barren field: flat green ground stretching to a distant red-brick monastery with a small tower on the horizon, a blue sky with long clouds.
rooms.24: A shallow lagoon: calm, clear shallow water over pale sand, the open ocean to the north beyond a line of surf, a quiet empty scene.
rooms.25: Inside a sacked and deserted monastery: broken timbers and wrecked furniture, a cracked red wall with an arched window, rubble on the floor.
rooms.26: Never Never Land: a magical landscape of rolling green hills, giant spotted toadstools, a waterfall, and a rainbow arching across a bright sky.
